How to Use

1. Introduction

This page provides a comprehensive guide to using the website: how to navigate the site, access features, interact with buttons, explore protected content, access multilingual versions, send feedback, and use external links.

This guide is designed both for first-time visitors and returning users.

2. Navigation and Buttons

  • All buttons lead to dedicated pages.
  • Some buttons (like "View in Index" or "Share to Social Media") activate specific functions.
  • If a button doesn't work, the linked page might not be published yet.
  • Buttons appear at the top, bottom, or middle of each page.
  • The "Updates" and "Search" buttons on the homepage direct users to guides, search tools, and site instructions.
  • Clicking on "Alireza Kaveh" next to the main image on any page will return you to the homepage.
  • On mobile devices, a "Categories" button gives access to subfolders.

3. Site Structure

4. Secure and View-Only Pages

  • Some content is view-only (e.g., full books or scripts).
  • These pages cannot be saved or downloaded.
  • Such restrictions protect copyright and intellectual property.
  • Access is browser-based only.
  • These pages are marked with a "View-only" label.

5. Multilingual Navigation

  • Main pages are available in both Persian and English.
  • A language switch button at the top lets users switch between available languages.
  • If a page exists in only one language, the other will be added later.

6. FAQ

  • Why can’t some folders be downloaded?
  • How do I use the GPT?
  • How do I become a member or request collaboration?
  • How can I re-publish content?

7. Support and Contact

  • For suggestions, bug reports, or collaboration inquiries, use the [Contact Page].
  • Special support is available for programs or academic collaborations upon request.

8. Submitting Feedback

  • Many pages include a section for submitting feedback.
  • You can share comments on the content or ideas for improvement.
  • Valuable or scholarly feedback may be referenced in future editions or public releases.

9. Sharing to Social Media

  • Below posts, you’ll find buttons to share content directly on platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Telegram, or WhatsApp.
  • Official social profiles are listed on the [Links Page].

10. External Link Hub

The [Links Page] offers verified access to external platforms featuring Alireza Kaveh’s work:

  • IMDb
  • Google Books
  • Google Scholar
  • ORCID
  • Internet Archive
  • YouTube
  • Facebook
  • Other professional repositories

11. Thematic Index

  • For a complete overview of all content, visit the [Index Page].
  • The index includes:
  • A structural list of all website pages
  • An alphabetical index of key terms, people, works, and theories

This resource is ideal for students, researchers, and professionals.
